description: Source code for the ScreenCapture plugin, handling screenshot capture, PNG encoding, and uploading via HTTP, with platform-specific implementations for Broadcom and Intel.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Main plugin class handling screenshot capture, upload, and platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: ScreenShotJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job for taking and uploading a screenshot.

methods.name: uploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Handles request to upload a screenshot based on provided parameters.

methods.name: doUploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Performs the process of capturing and uploading a screenshot.

methods.name: getScreenshotIntel
methods.description: Captures a screenshot on Intel platforms by reading from a specific device file.

methods.name: joinNexus
methods.description: Initializes connection to Nexus platform for Broadcom devices.

methods.name: getScreenshotNexus
methods.description: Captures a screenshot from Nexus platform on Broadcom devices.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads PNG data to specified URL using libcurl.

methods.name: saveToPng
methods.description: Encodes raw RGBA data into PNG format using libpng.
